From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close-clockwork: AcmeHealth claim-or-freeze sprint

Team — finance flagged ACME as a top risk in the May forecast (large upside but low evidence). I ran a quick SF extract (attached) — there are six open opportunities tied to the account across two buying centers. We need a swift tidy: either claim (provide evidence / updated close plan) or freeze (archive/convert to nurture) to protect Q2 predictability.

Ask (48 hours):
- Owners: review the six opp records in SF and update stage + close date truthfully.
- If still committed, reply with 1) next milestone, 2) contract attach or expected PO date, 3) who is owning procurement follow-up.
- If not moving this quarter: change stage to "Nurture" and add a short note (reason + next touch date).

Quick checklist (please paste into the opp comments):
- Evidence: signed SOW / PO / CLM link or procurement email
- Expected ARR and proposed close date
- Any gating items (security, legal, budget) + owner

I attached the SF extract and highlighted which opps lack close-proof. Finance will re-run the forecast Thu morning — items not addressed will be moved to deferred. If you need a short review call, ping and I’ll set one.

Attachments: sf-closeclock-report.csv (SF export, flagged columns: evidence_missing)

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
